description: Search map events: battles (Wikidata), UCDP armed-conflict events since 1989, volcanic eruptions VEI 4+ (Smithsonian GVP), significant earthquakes (NOAA), witnessed meteorite falls, and UNESCO World Heritage sites (undated). Month/day bounds match only events recorded at least that precisely; undated heritage sites match only searches without a date bound. Results are sorted by date.

bbox.description: Bounding box [west, south, east, north] in degrees.

from_date.description: Source-calendar date fields at month precision, or day precision when day is supplied. Historical sources may use Julian dates; bounds compare their recorded fields without calendar conversion.

year.description: Year. Negative is BC: -500 = 500 BC. There is no year 0.

from_year.description: Year. Negative is BC: -500 = 500 BC. There is no year 0.

query.description: Substring of the event name or detail, e.g. "Vienna".

to_date.description: Source-calendar date fields at month precision, or day precision when day is supplied. Historical sources may use Julian dates; bounds compare their recorded fields without calendar conversion.

to_year.description: Year. Negative is BC: -500 = 500 BC. There is no year 0.
